title: Northgate Memberships Annual Fee and Segment Schedule
content:
Northgate Memberships are sold at six tiers. Each tier belongs to one segment, consumer or business, and carries its own annual fee for one membership year; the membership year at every tier runs 12 calendar months.

## Schedule of fees

| Tier | Segment | Annual fee (USD, per membership year) | Plus premium (USD) | Business add-on card fee (USD, per card, per membership year) | Add-on fee reduced for a card issued mid-year | Length of one membership year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | consumer | 32.50 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | 12 calendar months |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | consumer | 45.50 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | 12 calendar months |
| Northgate Club Membership | consumer | 65.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | 12 calendar months |
| Northgate Business Membership | business | 65.00 | 0.00 | 65.00 | No | 12 calendar months |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | consumer | 130.00 | 65.00 | 0.00 | No | 12 calendar months |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | business | 130.00 | 65.00 | 65.00 | No | 12 calendar months |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Annual fee.** The annual fee is the fee for one membership year at the tier; it is charged on enrollment and on every renewal.
2. **Segment.** The segment is the one the tier belongs to. A person may hold at most one membership per segment.
3. **Plus premium.** The Plus premium is the part of a Plus tier's annual fee above its base tier's fee, and it is the threshold of the Annual Reward guarantee. It is 0.00 on every tier that is not a Plus tier.
4. **Business add-on card fee.** The add-on card fee is charged for each business add-on card for each membership year. At every tier the column "reduced for a card issued mid-year" reads No: no tier charges an add-on card issued part-way through the year only for the remaining whole months.
5. **Membership year.** One membership year is 12 calendar months long at every tier.

## Reading the schedule

- *Which tiers are business tiers?* Northgate Business Membership and Northgate Business Plus Membership. The other four tiers are consumer tiers.
- *Which tiers carry a Plus premium?* Only Northgate Club Plus Membership and Northgate Business Plus Membership, each 65.00 dollars.
- *Which tiers carry an add-on card fee?* Only the two business tiers, 65.00 dollars per card per membership year; the consumer tiers show 0.00.

## Derived check (from the schedule itself)

The Plus premium of each Plus tier equals its annual fee less the annual fee of its base tier: Northgate Club Plus Membership 130.00 less Northgate Club Membership 65.00 gives 65.00, and Northgate Business Plus Membership 130.00 less Northgate Business Membership 65.00 gives 65.00 — the figures shown in the Plus premium column.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a business membership that adds two add-on cards in a membership year carries add-on card fees of 65.00 dollars for each card, whatever the day in the year each card is issued, because no tier reduces the add-on fee for a mid-year issue.
